title: Sirène Perdue
lead: A figure awakens in a forest, covered in moss and bound by roots. A poetic short film about losing oneself and finding a way back.
text: Unable to recognise herself in an unfamiliar body, she struggles to break free. Her escape leads to a white cocoon where movement becomes transformation; emerging in a tulle dress, she follows the sound of sirens towards the water.
Rather than explaining the inner journey through dialogue, the film gives central importance to movement, texture, costume and the transformation of the body.
